purpose: Repair ordinary first- and second-person addressee grounding without live provider calls.
executive_summary: S03.3 and S05.3 no longer treat grammatical speech as an unidentified NPC. The established runner remains the recipient. S05.3's subject stays unresolved, and the existing resolver returns uncertainty rather than a new rumor. Related variations keep real ambiguity, explicit addressee changes, and off-scene rejection. Slice: 351 passed / 2 preexisting failed. No new relevant regression. Stop for external review.
